description: Check whether current market conditions are safe to execute a settlement. Call this before any large or time-sensitive payment. Returns a go/hold recommendation, stability score (0–100), status (STABLE/CAUTION/UNSTABLE), peg deviation in basis points, and AI synthesis of why conditions are as they are. Decision gates: STABLE (score ≥ 70, deviation < 50 bps) = execute any amount. CAUTION = execute under $500K, hold larger. UNSTABLE or deviation ≥ 50 bps = hold, do not settle. Applies to both cross-border and domestic settlements.
name: oracle.stability
